name: Library Volunteers, ages 13 and up (Nampa Public Library)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Nampa Public Library on a schedule you set with a manager. Volunteers help staff but do not replace them. At least two staff members must be present when volunteers under 18 are there.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be 13 or older. If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must sign a consent form. Library staff will talk with you. They may ask for personal references.
duration: Schedule set one-on-one with the library manager
deadline_text: The volunteer page says the library is not currently accepting volunteers. A reopening date is not stated.
how_to_apply: Email the Volunteer Coordinator at tolmanj@cityofnampa.us. You can find it on the volunteer page. Or call the library at 208-468-5800. Ask when applications open again.
notes: The site also lists a Teen Advisory Council under its Support section. The volunteer page does not explain how to join it.
